# Lekis Music (月兔音乐)

> Open-source, cross-platform local and NAS lossless music player built with Rust and Flutter. No server required.

## Canonical Identity
- **Name**: Lekis Music (Chinese: 月兔音乐)
- **Repository**: https://github.com/aoxzh/lekis-music
- **Android Application ID**: `dev.lekis.music`
- **License**: MPL-2.0 (FOSS, no proprietary blobs, no telemetry, no Google Play Services)
- **Platforms**: Android 8.0+ (arm64-v8a), Windows 10/11 (x64); macOS, iOS, and Linux planned for Beta.

## Key Differentiators
1. **Zero-Server NAS Playback**: Directly browses and plays music from Local folders, SMB, WebDAV, NFSv3, and SFTP with LAN auto-discovery (mDNS / WS-Discovery / SSDP) and automatic Home/Away failover.
2. **Media Server Compatibility**: Also supports OpenSubsonic (Navidrome, Gonic, Airsonic), Jellyfin, Emby, and Plex.
3. **Unified Library & Quality Deduplication**: Merges identical tracks across local storage, NAS, and media servers, selecting the best quality automatically, with one-click deletion of lower-quality duplicates.
4. **High-Performance Rust Audio Core**: Handles 100,000+ track libraries (~0.3s cold start, 120 fps UI), sample-accurate gapless playback, Windows WASAPI exclusive (bit-perfect) output, ReplayGain, 10-band EQ with headphone presets, and Last.fm / ListenBrainz / Libre.fm scrobbling.
5. **Zero-API-Key Metadata Enrichment & Lyrics**: Built-in cascading artwork (Cover Art Archive, iTunes Global/JP, Deezer, VocaDB, MusicBrainz) and synced lyrics (LRCLIB, etc.), CJK per-locale font fallback, and Windows native floating desktop lyrics (Win32 + Direct2D/DirectWrite).
6. **LAN Connect & Serverless Sync**: Remote control, queue transfer, and local track streaming between paired LAN devices; serverless multi-device sync for favorites, playlists, and play history over any shared folder.
7. **Extensible & Private**: Local JS plugin host, bilingual UI (English / Simplified Chinese), Vinyl/Cassette/Cover now-playing styles, zero accounts, zero tracking.
